description: A closing marker at the end of the file without a newline does not end the heredoc
notes: The prose says a heredoc ends when its marker appears on a line of its own, and prose outranks the Newline that the grammar puts after the closing identifier. The last line of a file is a line of its own even without a newline. hashicorp/hcl only recognizes the marker when a newline follows it (the heredocLiteralEOL action in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl matches a line together with its newline), although it doesn't require a newline after the last attribute of a file.
